description: Fix a crash that occurs when users retry importing a workspace after a previous backend import attempt has failed. Currently, the import process enters an inconsistent state that causes the application to crash on retry attempts. Ensure that the import flow properly resets its state and handles retry scenarios gracefully without crashing.
functional_requirements: Reset all import-related state variables when a user initiates a retry after a failed import
Ensure the import modal and form components properly handle retry attempts without throwing errors
Maintain user interface responsiveness during retry operations with appropriate loading indicators
Preserve any user-provided import data (like workspace file) when retrying the operation
